name: io.github.jztan/pdf-mcp
description: Agentic RAG over one PDF or a whole folder: hybrid search, selective page reads, tables, OCR.

environmentVariables.description: Optional time expiry in hours; unset keeps a document while its PDF exists
environmentVariables.name: PDF_MCP_CACHE_TTL

environmentVariables.description: Cache size cap in MB, least recently used evicted first (default: 2048; 0 = no cap)
environmentVariables.name: PDF_MCP_CACHE_MAX_MB
